name: logger-redact
prompt: Security review finding: our JSON logger writes passwords and tokens into the logs. Change src/logger.js so that, before a log line is written, every field whose key contains password, secret, token or authorization (case-insensitive, so accessToken and Authorization count) has its value replaced by the string "[REDACTED]", at any depth, including objects inside arrays. The caller's objects must not be modified, and the line format stays the same.
